items.stem: Formal analysis of an artwork primarily focuses on:

options.text: How visual elements such as line, colour, shape and composition are organised
options.rationale: Correct: formal analysis examines the visual organisation of the work.

options.text: The artist's biography above all else
options.rationale: That is biographical, not formal, analysis.

options.text: Only the monetary value of the work
options.rationale: Market value is not formal analysis.

options.text: The viewer's unexplained emotional reaction alone
options.rationale: Reaction is not structured formal analysis.

items.explanation: Correct: formal analysis examines the visual organisation of the work.

items.stem: Which TWO features most distinguish Baroque painting from High Renaissance painting? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Dramatic, directional light and strong contrast (chiaroscuro/tenebrism)
options.rationale: Correct: heightened dramatic light is characteristic of the Baroque.

options.text: Dynamic diagonal movement and theatrical energy
options.rationale: Correct: Baroque favours movement and drama over calm balance.

options.text: A preference for flat, symbolic, non-illusionistic space
Complete absence of religious subject matter

items.explanation: Correct: heightened dramatic light is characteristic of the Baroque.

options.rationale: Correct: iconography interprets subject matter and symbolism.
